Verify native learning, publication, ownership, initialized-project use and a comparable later scenario.

## Scope

- Observe actual manual and checkpoint review behavior
- Observe publication, retrieval and failure recovery

- Package checks pass; exact isolated roots and native scenario authority are established.

## Exit criteria

- Required native behaviors have reviewable actual evidence or remain explicitly unmet.

## Risks

- Keep real actors and current grants; do not fabricate receipts or turn fixtures into production adoption.
